_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The command palette uses indexed search and cancels superseded requests. The test harness has already stubbed the server's conversation list and cut off its live update stream, so there is nothing to set up, intercept or check about that (do not look at the API): the drawer (".drawer") shows the conversations the test names, as rows [data-conversation-id="<id>"] whose title (".conversation-title") is their slug, which is their id (drafts have none), and whose preview is "Preview". The list is "recent". Indexed searches answer with "needle-active" and "message-only", except that searches for "slow" and "cleared" never answer. Call "searches" lists the q of every indexed search so far, as JSON; calls "slow-requested" and "cleared-requested" say ("true"/"false") whether such a search was made, and "slow-cancelled" and "cleared-cancelled" whether the browser then cancelled it. Call "legacy" lists, as JSON, the URLs of every request for the legacy search (/api/conversations?...). "The input" is ".command-palette-input"; "titles" are ".command-palette-item-title" elements. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is the element with role button (a <button>) whose accessible name (aria-label, else its text) is exactly X; "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. Every selector you need is given here, so do not explore the source code or read other tests (the old Playwright spec is being replaced and does not apply): write all the steps in one run_steps call right away, and look something up only if a step fails. A button "X" is button[aria-label="X"] when one exists (as for "Open conversations", "Search conversations...", "Search tasks...", "View options", "Show chapters", "Archive", "Restore" and "Delete"); otherwise it is the button whose visible text is exactly X, picked with has_text X (a substring match, so make sure no other button's text contains X), as for "Ask Shelley", "View Archived" and "Back to conversations". 1. Navigate to /new. 2. Press "k" with modifiers "Control" to open the command palette. 3. A title containing "recent" should be visible. 4. Fill the input with "slow". 5. Call "slow-requested" until it returns "true". 6. Fill the input with " needle " (spaces included). 7. Call "slow-cancelled" until it returns "true". 8. The trimmed texts of the titles should be exactly ["needle-active","message-only"]. 9. The trimmed texts of the "mark" elements in the first title are exactly ["needle"]. 10. Fill the input with "cleared". 11. Call "cleared-requested" until it returns "true". 12. Fill the input with "" (empty). 13. Call "cleared-cancelled" until it returns "true". 14. A title containing "recent" should be visible, and no title contains "needle-active". 15. Call "searches" must return exactly ["slow","needle","cleared"], and call "legacy" exactly [].
